title: Step 1b: Uploading & Preprocessing Data for Decision Tree Regression in Python

cues.en: Speaker: All right, so we're almost ready to start now.
cues.zh: 現在快準備好了。

cues.en: We are going just to upload, you know the data set by clicking this little folder here.
cues.zh: 點這個小資料夾，準備上傳資料集。

cues.en: And then right now it is connecting to runtime to enable file browsing.
cues.zh: 它正在連接執行環境，以啟用檔案瀏覽。

cues.en: And in a second we should be able to see the upload button.
cues.zh: 稍等一下，應該會看到上傳按鈕。

cues.en: Here we go, to upload indeed the data set.
cues.zh: 出現了，用它上傳資料集。

cues.en: And now we are on my desktop.
cues.zh: 現在來到我的桌面。

cues.en: That's where I put my machine learning exit folder.
cues.zh: 我將 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾放在這裡。

cues.en: But make sure to go wherever you saved it.
cues.zh: 請前往你儲存的位置。

cues.en: And now, inside, we're gonna go to part to regression and then decision tree regression, and then Python.
cues.zh: 進入 Part 2 Regression、Decision Tree Regression，再到 Python。

cues.en: And then there you go.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: You select your position, salaries, dataset, and click open.
cues.zh: 選取 Position Salaries 資料集，點 Open。

cues.en: And this will upload the dataset inside the notebook.
cues.zh: 資料集就會上傳到筆記本。

cues.en: And now we are ready to start.
cues.zh: 現在可以開始。

cues.en: Let's just run these two cells here.
cues.zh: 先執行這兩個儲存格。

cues.en: The first one to import the libraries and then the second one to import the dataset.
cues.zh: 第一個匯入函式庫，第二個匯入資料集。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So now we have the dataset and of course the matrix of features X containing only the position levels and the dependent variable vector containing the salaries.
cues.zh: 現在已有資料集，以及只包含職等的特徵矩陣 X，和包含薪資的應變數向量。

cues.en: Alright, and here, quick reminder this model that we are about to build you will totally be able to implement it on your dataset and you will only have two things to change
cues.zh: 提醒一下，這個模型完全可以套用到自己的資料集，只需修改兩件事，

cues.en: which are first, of course, the name of the dataset.
cues.zh: 第一當然是資料集名稱。

cues.en: Here, you will put the name of your data set.
cues.zh: 在這裡填入自己的資料集名稱。

cues.en: And then in a matrix of features, well, maybe you will want to select all the columns.
cues.zh: 然後是特徵矩陣，你可能想選取所有欄位。

cues.en: And here we just excluded the first column because this contained only the positions and strings which are exactly the same as the levels in this column.
cues.zh: 我們排除第一欄，因為其中的職位字串，和這一欄的職等其實表達相同資訊。

cues.en: So, of course, we didn't want to include it but check your data sets.
cues.zh: 所以不納入，但請檢查自己的資料集。

cues.en: Check if you want to include all the columns.
cues.zh: 看看是否要包含所有欄位。

cues.en: And mostly check if you need to apply some of the tools of your data processing toolkit, which are either you know, taking care of missing data or encoding category
cues.zh: 最重要的是，確認是否需要前處理工具，例如處理缺失值，或將類別

cues.en: called data, right?
cues.zh: 資料編碼。

cues.en: So you would need to check the variables and see if there are some category called variables and strings.
cues.zh: 檢查變數是否包含以字串表示的類別變數。

cues.en: If the order matters, like for example, the size of a close well, you will apply labeling coder and if the order doesn't matter, like some countries or some states
cues.zh: 如果順序有意義，例如衣服尺寸，就用 LabelEncoder；如果順序無關，例如國家或州，

cues.en: well, you will apply column transformer with one Haughton coder, alright?
cues.zh: 就使用 ColumnTransformer 搭配 OneHotEncoder。

cues.en: And then you don't have to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 之後不用做特徵縮放。

cues.en: You can totally split your data set into the training set test set if you want to evaluate your model on new observations.
cues.zh: 如果想用新觀測值評估模型，可以將資料分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: But you don't have to apply feature scaling for decision tree regression and neither for random forest regression.
cues.zh: 但決策樹迴歸和隨機森林迴歸，都不必做特徵縮放。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: That's because you know, the predictions from decision tree regression or random forest regression model are resulting from successive splits of the data, you know, through the different nodes of your tree.
cues.zh: 因為這兩種模型的預測，是透過樹的不同節點，接連切分資料而產生。

cues.en: And therefore there are not some equations like with the previous models.
cues.zh: 不像前面的模型依賴方程式。

cues.en: And that's why of course, no feature scaling is needed to you know, split the different values of your feature into these different categories leading to different predictions.
cues.zh: 因此不需要特徵縮放，也能將特徵值分到不同區域，做出不同預測。

cues.en: We can still do this with the original scale of your features even if your features take different ranges of values.
cues.zh: 即使不同特徵的值域不同，仍能使用原始尺度。

cues.en: All right, so remember this no feature scaling and then check for the other tools.
cues.zh: 記住，不需要特徵縮放，但要檢查其他工具是否有需要。

cues.en: But just for your future data sets where you would like to apply decision tree regression.
cues.zh: 這是日後將決策樹迴歸用於其他資料集時的提醒。

cues.en: Okay, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So we have everything.
cues.zh: 所有資料都準備好了。

cues.en: We have the data set, and now we are ready to build the decision tree regression model on the whole data set, right?
cues.zh: 已經有資料集，現在可以在完整資料集上建立決策樹迴歸模型。

cues.en: This time we don't want to split it.
cues.zh: 這次不分割資料。

cues.en: We want to leverage the maximum data to understand the correlations in this small amount of information.
cues.zh: 因為資料量很少，要盡量利用所有資料，了解其中關聯。

cues.en: So we will train it on the whole data set.
cues.zh: 所以在完整資料集上訓練。

cues.en: Then we will predict our final result, you know the salary of the position level number 6.5.
cues.zh: 接著預測最終結果，也就是職等 6.5 的薪資。

cues.en: And then at the end we will visualize what the regression curve of the decision tree regression model looks like.
cues.zh: 最後視覺化，看看決策樹迴歸的曲線長什麼樣。

cues.en: All right, So let's do all this in the next three tutorials, starting with this step training the decision tree regression model on the whole data set.
cues.zh: 接下來三個教學會完成這些步驟，先在完整資料集上訓練決策樹迴歸模型。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
